title: SMS Formats
intro: The SMS gateway forwards every message to Customer Care unchanged. These formats decide what a message is (a mobile-money payment or a balance request) for {{country}}. Changes apply within 30 seconds, without a deploy.
denied: Only Admin, IT and O&M staff can manage SMS formats.
orderNote: Formats are tried in priority order (lowest first), then the built-in parsers.
templateHelp: Copy a real SMS and replace the variable parts with placeholders. {*} skips any text. Insert:
regexHelp: Python regular expression with named groups: amount (required for payments), account, phone, txn_id, remark.
samplesHelp: Samples are real SMS this format must read correctly. They are re-checked on every save, so a later edit cannot silently break them.
untrustedSender: Sender is not in the trusted list (mode: {{mode}}).
previewTitle: Impact on the last 30 days of SMS
previewCounts: {{total}} SMS checked: {{newly_parsed}} newly recognised, {{changed}} read differently, {{no_longer_parsed}} no longer recognised, {{unchanged}} unchanged.
previewWarning: Some messages that work today would change. Check the examples before saving.
unprocessedIntro: SMS from the last 30 days that were not recognised, had no matching account, or came from an untrusted sender. After adding a format, replay them to credit the customer. Payments already entered by hand (for example on Record Payment) are flagged and skipped unless you allow them.
allowDupes: Replay even if a similar manual payment exists
trustedIntro: Payment confirmations should only come from the mobile-money provider (e.g. “MTN MoMo”, “MPESA”, “199”). Anyone can text the gateway phone, so a fake “payment” SMS from a customer’s handset must not credit an account. Start in “Warn” mode, check the logs, then switch to “Enforce”. A format with a sender pattern counts as trusted.
observedTitle: Senders seen in the last 30 days
balanceIntro: When enabled, Customer Care answers balance-request SMS itself (add a “Balance request” format, e.g. “Balance {account}”). Turn this on only when the gateway’s own balance replies are switched off, or customers get two replies.
balanceEnabled: Customer Care replies to balance requests
unregisteredTemplate: Reply when the number is not registered
